parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for the details. We can help coordinate the DPA clarifications with our privacy/compliance team.

To route this to the right privacy contact and ensure we respond with the correct document/version, could you please share:
1) Which DPA (or link/version) your legal team is reviewing
2) Any specific questions they’ve asked regarding:
   - subprocessors (name list vs. general commitment)
   - data retention (e.g., retention periods for which data types)
   - support logs (whether they mean account IDs, customer names, emails, or other identifiers)
3) If you have a deadline/timeline for enabling EU customer records

Once we have the above, we’ll escalate internally to our privacy/compliance contact to provide the requested confirmations and guidance for your legal review.
promised_actions: Escalate the request to the privacy/compliance contact after receiving the missing details.
Confirm which DPA/version is being reviewed so responses match your legal team’s document.
safety_notes: Do not confirm subprocessors/retention/logging details until privacy/compliance review is complete.
Acknowledge operational impact and that the request needs human review, without promising a specific turnaround time or resolution.
